# Orivion

Orivion provides two connected service groups: UAE Business Setup Services and Digital & Technology services.

## Business Setup Services

- Company Formation: Mainland, Free Zone and Offshore formation support.
- Trade Licensing: New licences, renewals, amendments and activity changes.
- PRO Services: Company, investor, employee and dependant government paperwork.
- Compliance & Regulatory: UBO, AML, Corporate Tax registration and recurring record support.
- Accounting & Tax: Bookkeeping, VAT, Corporate Tax, payroll and audit coordination.
- Banking Support: Business bank account preparation and KYC coordination.
- Office Solutions: Registered address, flexi-desk and physical workspace support.
- Additional Services: Document clearing, business planning, restructuring and closure support.

## Digital & Technology

- Websites & Platforms: UX, design, development, CMS, accessibility, SEO and performance.
- Custom Software: Web applications, portals, internal tools, APIs and integrations.
- CRM & Automation: CRM setup, sales workflows, business automation and dashboards.
- Digital Marketing: SEO, paid media, email, analytics and conversion improvement.
- Social Media: Strategy, content production, channel management and reporting.
- AI Integration: Assistants, document workflows, automation, evaluation and guardrails.
